summary: Boston Scientific filed an 8-K reporting its investment agreement with MiRus LLC. It acquired a 33.75% non-voting equity interest for $1.5B cash (plus a prior $100M payment) and an exclusive call option to acquire TAVR-Structural Heart NewCo for $3.0B upon clinical/regulatory milestones, netting 100% ownership. If the option is exercised, Boston Scientific forfeits its MiRus stake. At exercise, MiRus may receive additional net-sales-based payments. The transaction includes a separate option for mitral/tricuspid assets. No termination fees or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for trial milestones and regulatory progress to trigger the call option.
